name: BSCC PC1 / BSCCnet cable landing station (CAP-N)
notes: Palau's first international submarine fibre cable (PC1, SEA-US branch) ready for service Dec 2017, landed at the Ngeremlengui Cable Landing Station / Capacity Access Point CAP-N, built with ADB support. Cable landing station + telecom equipment room - telecom infrastructure, NOT a commercial datacenter (no colo services offered per methodology). Capacity is telecom (wavelengths/bandwidth), not IT MW.

name: BSCC PC2 / Echo Palau Branch cable landing station
developer: BSCC with AIFFP financing; NEC system; DXN modular CLS
notes: Palau's second international cable (PC2, dedicated branch of the Meta/Google-led Echo network) with a modular cable landing station at Ngardmau; pre-lay shore end landed June 2022. BSCC FY2025-2029 plan expects PC2 Ready for Service in Q3 2026; AIFFP 2026 fact sheet cites mid-2026 completion. Under construction / pre-service telecom infrastructure, not a commercial datacenter.

name: BSCC CAP-A customer access point (Airai airport)
notes: BSCC customer access point at Airai (long-term CAP-A target at the airport site; temporary access at KB Shell corner per FY2022-2026 plan). Customer access / telecom equipment point, not a commercial datacenter.

name: PNCC internal exchange / server facilities (Airai)
notes: PNCC internal telecom exchanges and server rooms serving Airai/airport and retail service locations; no public MW/rack data and no public commercial colocation offering found. Operator existence A; facility details unverified.

name: PNCC internal exchange / server facilities (Koror)
notes: PNCC is Palau's incumbent national communications provider (mobile/internet/telephone/digital TV) with internal telecom exchanges and server rooms in Koror; no public MW/rack data and no public commercial colocation offering found. Operator existence A; facility details unverified.

name: DC Alliance / Pacific Blockchain Tier III data centre proposal (site unnamed)
developer: DC Alliance Pte Ltd (Figtree Holdings 27.5% associate) with Pacific Blockchain Corporation
notes: Only public commercial datacenter proposal for Palau: non-binding 12-month MOU signed 10 Feb 2022 between DC Alliance and Palau-based Pacific Blockchain Corporation to explore a Tier III data centre; proposal capacity 1 MW / up to 200 racks initially, potential 5 MW / up to 1,000 racks (SGX filing = A for MOU terms). No site named in the MOU; assigned to Koror as likely business-centre location per methodology - UNVERIFIED. No construction/operation follow-up found through 2026-08-12; keep status announced (stale MOU) - do NOT upgrade to planned/construction.
